<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="685.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="685.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>

<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="911" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
